children: Japanese government bond yields are lower as investors seek the safety of sovereign bonds amid stock market selloffs. Recent declines in crude-oil prices have eased fears about rising prices of energy and other related products, lowering expectations for fast-paced rate increases by the Bank of Japan. Investors are also focusing on developments in the Middle East after Democrats won control of Congress in the U.S. following midterm elections. The 2-year JGB yield is down 8.5 basis points at 1.770% and the 10-year yield is 8 basis points lower at 2.675%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
